text.en:
Section one of Republic Act No. 3538 as amended, is hereby further amended to include the
International Institute of Rural Reconstruction of New York as recipient of the exemptions and privileges
provided in the said section.

Section 2 of the same Act is hereby amended to include non-Filipino citizens serving on the staff
of the International Institute of Rural Reconstruction as beneficiaries of the exemptions and privileges
provided in said section.

All laws, decrees, orders and regulations inconsistent with the provisions of this decree are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 5th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-five.
